failure_cases.expectation: Verifier fails if the ZIP is missing.
Verifier fails if the ZIP SHA256 does not match the manifest and sha256 file.
Verifier fails if the ZIP omits transfer-package-contents-manifest.json.
Verifier fails if the p2-98 dossier snapshot is absent from the ZIP.
Verifier fails if any archived file hash diverges from its source hash.
Verifier fails if the package claims Opus approval.
Verifier fails if the package claims mainline readiness.
Verifier fails if the package claims reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
Verifier fails if the package claims the full goal is complete.
Verifier fails if __pycache__, .pyc, or temporary files appear in the package.
